article.title: Acusativo: plural inanimado
article.chapter: Acusativo y animacidad — Винительный падеж и одушевлённость

claims.summary: Across noun declensions, plural inanimate accusative matches nominative, while animate accusative matches genitive.
The source attests the two exact examples and the role of animacy in the accusative plural.
Я знаю эти рестораны and Я знаю этих профессоров are directly attested as inanimate/animate accusative plural examples.
The article confines the generalization to plural and grammatical animacy.
